description.en: An introduction to computational structural biology: protein structure determination, molecular docking with HADDOCK, SwissDock and PRISM, and molecular dynamics with NAMD.
description.tr: Hesaplamalı yapısal biyolojiye giriş: protein yapı belirleme, HADDOCK, SwissDock ve PRISM ile moleküler yerleştirme, NAMD ile moleküler dinamik.
